about_the_game:
Bonesaw: Gambling Severed Fingers!

Your goal is to eliminate both of your opponents' hands to save yourself from eternal damnation. This is the Devil's game, and he's out to claim your soul... and your fingers!

Beware the Saw

Adding fear and chaos to the mix, the saw is out to chop some fingers! Combining skill with a little luck lets you control the blade to your advantage. Will you be brave enough to ring the bell to unleash it?

Special Abilities

Strategize carefully, steal from your opponent or combine the effects of various items to take the upper hand.

Full version only: Play Solo or Face Off Against a Friend

Play against different opponents in a gripping single player experience with 3 distinct game modes, or challenge a friend in local multiplayer or online via Steam Remote Play. Who wouldn't want to chop their friend's fingers off…right?

In the demo, you can access both the tutorial and the Sheriff character.

How To Play

The demo includes a hands-on interactive tutorial.

The Goal:

  • The first player to accumulate 3 points (win 3 rounds) wins the game.

  • To win a round, players must be the first to eliminate both of their opponent’s hands. A hand is removed from play when its total finger count is reached or when it’s severed by the saw.

Player Turn:

  • Play chips and power cards to gain special abilities.

  • Attack an opponent’s hand and add the number of fingers from your attacking hand to theirs. If the attack total exceeds the number of fingers on the targeted hand, the count resets and the remaining amount is added.

Or

  • Attack the bell to activate the saw. Additional attacks on the bell will move the blade clockwise around the active hands to have it target another hand. 

Gameplay:

  • The skeleton is a passive side player. Be the first to eliminate him to earn a power card, granting a unique and game-changing ability.

  • When active, the saw has a chance to sever a hand at the end of each turn. The gauge surrounding the bell displays the chances of the saw cutting.

  • Every finger lost changes drastically the dynamic and strategies of the following rounds!

content_descriptors.notes: The game displays lacerated fingers and blood spilled on the table. During the sawing or cutting scenes, the camera shifts away, going out of focus or fading to darkness. Only the severed fingers are shown on the table afterward, providing a visual cue of how many fingers the player has lost.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Less than 15 years old CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3570K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 960 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Gamble your fingers against the Sheriff and the Devil's bloodthirsty saw in this turn-based strategy game. Outsmart your opponent with special abilities, or test your luck as you defy the odds to escape with your fingers!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
